title: antiostelma lantsangense
intro: Antiostelma lantsangense, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae, is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Tibetan medicine. Research has shown that it possesses numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Antiostelma lantsangense include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
